user.title: Add Aerohive / Extreme Networks device
user.description: Find access points, branch routers and switches on your network automatically, or enter an IP address yourself.

manual.title: Enter device details
manual.description: Connect to an access point or branch router over SSH. Provide a password, an SSH private key path, or both.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the device.
data_description.ssh_key_path: Absolute path to a private key file readable by Home Assistant, e.g. /config/.ssh/aerohive.
data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between polls. Keep this at 60 or higher for a BR100.

pick.title: Pick a discovered device
pick.description: Found {count} likely Aerohive/Extreme device(s) out of {total} SSH devices. Pick one (or type an IP) and enter its CLI login.

data_description.ssh_key_path: Absolute path to a private key file readable by Home Assistant, e.g. /config/.ssh/aerohive.
data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between polls. Keep this at 60 or higher for a BR100.

discovery_confirm.title: Set up {name}
discovery_confirm.description: Found an Aerohive / Extreme Networks device at {host}. Enter its CLI login to add it.

data_description.ssh_key_path: Absolute path to a private key file readable by Home Assistant, e.g. /config/.ssh/aerohive.
data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between polls. Keep this at 60 or higher for a BR100.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The device rejected the stored credentials.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Check host, port and that SSH is enabled on the device.
error.invalid_key: The SSH key file could not be read.
error.password_or_key: Enter a password or an SSH key path.
error.no_devices_found: No devices found by the network scan. Enter the IP address manually.

abort.already_in_progress: Setup for this device is already in progress.

progress.scanning: Scanning the local network for SSH devices. This takes up to about 15 seconds.

data.raw_sensors: Create sensors for every raw field

data_description.tracked_clients: Create a device tracker and detail sensors (signal, SNR, rates, SSID) only for these client MAC addresses (pick from connected clients or type a MAC).
data_description.detailed_stats: Throughput and counters for Ethernet ports and SSID sub-interfaces, plus CPU and memory. Adds a few CLI commands per poll; turn off for a slow BR100.
data_description.raw_sensors: One sensor (disabled by default) for every other field the CLI reports, so you can enable anything you need.
data_description.enable_all_entities: Turn on every entity, including the diagnostic ones that are disabled by default (counters, raw fields, port switches).

wifi.title: Wi-Fi networks
wifi.description:
{message}

Pick a network to change its password, where it broadcasts, or to delete it. Or add a new one.

wifi_edit.title: Edit {ssid}
wifi_edit.description:
{message}

Leave the password empty to keep the current one. Changes are applied together and saved on the device.

data_description.password: 8-63 characters. The current password can't be shown: the device stores it encrypted.
data_description.radios: Untick every radio to stop broadcasting without deleting the network.

data_description.password: WPA2-PSK, 8-63 characters. Leave empty for an open network.
data_description.access_points: Create it on these access points.

wifi_delete.title: Delete {ssid}?
wifi_delete.description: This removes the network from the device and saves the configuration. Clients connected to it will be disconnected.

error.invalid_mac: One of the entries is not a valid MAC address.
error.invalid_password: The password must be 8-63 printable characters, without double quotes.
error.invalid_ssid_name: The name must be 1-32 printable characters, without double quotes.
error.ssid_exists: A network with this name already exists.

abort.device_unavailable: The device isn't reachable right now. Try again in a minute.

run_show_command.name: Run show command
run_show_command.description: Run a read-only 'show' command on the device and return the raw output (for capturing parser samples).

command.name: Command
command.description: A command starting with 'show', e.g. 'show station'.

redact.name: Redact secrets
redact.description: Mask key/password arguments in the output.

set_ssid_password.name: Set SSID password
set_ssid_password.description: Change the WPA2-PSK key of an SSID and save the configuration.

password.name: Password
password.description: New key, 8-63 printable ASCII characters (no double quotes).

security_object.name: Security object
security_object.description: Security-object name. Looked up in the running config if omitted (falls back to the SSID name).

disconnect_client.name: Disconnect client
disconnect_client.description: De-authenticate a wireless client by MAC address.

mac.name: MAC address
mac.description: Client MAC address in any common format.

create_ssid.name: Create SSID
create_ssid.description: Create a new Wi-Fi network (security-object + SSID) and broadcast it, then save the configuration.

password.name: Password
password.description: WPA2-PSK key (8-63 characters). Leave empty for an open network.

radios.name: Radios
radios.description: Radios to broadcast on, e.g. wifi0, wifi1. Default: all active radios.

delete_ssid.name: Delete SSID
delete_ssid.description: Stop broadcasting an SSID and remove it (and its own security-object) from the configuration.

power_cycle_poe.name: Power cycle PoE port
power_cycle_poe.description: Turn PoE off for 5 seconds and on again (switches).

set_port.name: Enable or disable a port
set_port.description: Turn an Ethernet port on or off and save the configuration. Uplink ports are protected unless force is set.

force.name: Force
force.description: Also allow turning off an uplink port (may disconnect Home Assistant from the device).
